P1.22.text: Huron is a global professional services firm that collaborates with organizations to help solve their most complex challenges and achieve their most ambitious goals. Working across the private and public sectors, we partner closely with clients to improve performance, accelerate transformation, and unlock new opportunities for growth.

P1.23.text: Our clients choose us because of our deep industry and technical expertise and proven track record of turning sound strategies into action. By combining practical experience, innovative thinking, and advanced analytics and technology, Huron helps organizations translate today’s ideas into tangible results and long-term value.

P2.2.text: Huron is a global professional services firm that collaborates with organizations to help solve their most complex challenges and achieve their most ambitious goals.

P2.3.text: We believe that meaningful, lasting change happens when the right expertise, collaboration, and innovation meet. We work shoulder-to-shoulder with our clients, taking the time to understand their unique business, culture, challenges, and long-term goals. That context helps shape what we do from the solutions we design to how we implement them.

P2.4.text: Our approach blends deep industry and technical knowledge with data-informed insights and practical, proven experience. We work with agility and transparency, engaging stakeholders throughout the process and adapting as needs and the market evolve so solutions are effective and sustainable.

P2.5.text: By fostering trust, encouraging collaboration, and focusing on measurable outcomes, we help organizations not only address immediate needs but also build resilience and own the future.

P2.6.text: We collaborate with leading technology providers to stay on the cutting edge of a rapidly evolving landscape and implement the right solutions faster—integrating people, processes, data, and platform together to optimize operations and leverage technology investments to deliver measurable outcomes and scalable change.

P2.8.text: We foster a culture of collaboration, curiosity, and innovation, equipping our teams to solve complex challenges and deliver exceptional results.

P1.1.text: TruBridge: RCM, EHR & Financial Solutions for Hospitals

P1.2.text: Healthcare Revenue Cycle & EHR Solutions That Drive Results

P1.3.text: From towns of 200 to cities of 200,000, TruBridge has the solutions your healthcare organization needs to stay independent and financially stable.

P1.4.text: Creating Stronger Communities Through Better Healthcare

P1.5.text: TruBridge helps rural hospitals, critical access hospitals, community hospitals, and clinics stay financially strong and achieve better financial, operational, and clinical outcomes. We offer technology and revenue cycle management services backed by more than 45 years of healthcare experience and trusted by multiple clients across the U.S.

P1.6.text: Technology & Services Built for Healthcare Performance

P1.7.text: We deliver revenue cycle services, medical coding support, and EHR technology tailored to community-based healthcare organizations, ensuring operational strength so high-quality care can stay close to home. We combine proven healthcare technology with specialized support teams so you can improve productivity, strengthen revenue, and deliver better patient care.

P1.9.text: EHR solutions that simplify workflows, improve data access, and support smarter care decisions for your teams.

P1.11.text: Ensure accurate coding, compliance, and optimized reimbursement with expert coding services and technology.

P1.13.text: Maximize revenue, reduce denials, and strengthen financial performance while keeping care close to your community.

P1.15.text: End-to-end revenue cycle management solutions and services for hospitals, critical access facilities, and ambulatory clinics.

P1.16.text: Whether your town has one stoplight, or you’re part of a larger community, TruBridge solutions are designed with your organization in mind. We serve hospitals, ambulatory clinics, and physicians.

P1.17.text: Supporting your financial and clinical health

P1.18.text: Helping providers save time, money and clear the way for care

P1.19.text: Empowering ambulatory care to keep moving forward

P1.20.text: Achieving impactful goals with industry-leading solutions

P1.21.text: We don’t deal in one-size-fits-all solutions. We treat each client as a unique case, joining data-driven insights with our wealth of experience to create a solution that delivers the results they need. Through a suite of innovative products and collaborative services, we help our clients eliminate the financial and operational obstacles holding them back and lay the foundation for lasting success. We are a healthcare solutions company and we clear the way for care®.

P1.22.text: nTrust is a flexible, minimal risk program that lets you access our leading revenue cycle solutions and future product innovations with no upfront costs, maintenance charges or future licensing fees. We simply extract a percentage of your collections to cover costs, meaning we don’t get paid until you do.

P1.23.text: Reduce AR days by 30% with RCM

P1.24.text: Focus on what matters: care for your patients

P1.25.text: Recover up to 70% of denied claims

P1.26.text: Achieve collection goals while effectively managing your team’s workload

P1.27.text: Let our AR Clean Up collections experts work your aging small balance co-pays, low-dollar insurance claims and other time-consuming tasks to deliver results that truly add up.

P1.28.text: Bayou Bend needed a more effective way to ensure reimbursements matched contracted rates without adding staff or administrative burden. By consistently comparing actual payments against contracted rates across all claims, the team could identify discrepancies more efficiently.

P1.29.text: Clearing the way for care through real client success

P1.30.text: Every healthcare organization has a story of overcoming challenges to better serve its community. We partner with hospitals and health systems to remove barriers, streamline operations, and strengthen financial and clinical performance so providers can focus on what matters most: delivering exceptional patient care. Learn more how our clients are creating lasting impact with the support of TruBridge.

P1.31.text: Recognized Leader in Rural Hospital Revenue Cycle Solutions
